name: character-reel-kit
description: Skills for making two-character comedy reels with Claude Code, distilled from a real production.

plugins.name: character-reel
plugins.description: Make a short two-character comedy reel with /character-reel: a mascot and a human in a three.js set, voiced by ElevenLabs v3 as one acted conversation, timing re-anchored to Whisper so captions never drift, gap-free line tiling, beat-cut camera with two-shot facing cheats, sentence-aware captions with time digits, ducked music mix, and scripted gates (caption sync, loudness, true peak, length).
